newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Prices improve at Christchurch and Napier sales.
newsitem.headline: Prices improve at Christchurch and Napier sales.

text.p: Prices improved at Thursday's Christchurch and Napier wool sales although prices for average and poorer style wools weakened, Wools of New Zealand said.
The final market indicator rose seven cents to 434 cents with the fine sement down 60 to 851, medium up 12 to 561, strong up five to 374 and lamb up four to 384.
Some 20 percent of the 3295 tonnes on offer was passed in. Crossbred fleece made up 29 percent of the offering, second shear 30 percent, lambswool 16 percent and halfbred fleece six percent.
